About the collection

Twenty sleeves across rock, pop, jazz, soul, folk, electronic, alternative, and rap. An experiment in browsing music as a physical object. Cover artwork belongs to its respective rights holders; images sourced from Apple’s album catalog. The vinyl and reverse sleeves are interpretive, with short notes about each cover.
